column3: Required local source hygiene; ci-verify adds producer dependencies.
Compiler and test sources can affect every compiler consumer, including target references and parity.
Embedded sources affect compiler builds and all consumers, including pinned safety diagnostics.

Only the safety runner consumes this case/expectation table.
